Layout transition objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_layout_transition.Rd

Sets transition options used during Plotly.react updates.

Usage

go_layout_transition(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  duration = NULL,
  easing = NULL,
  ordering = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

duration

The duration of the transition, in milliseconds. If equal to zero, updates are synchronous. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

easing

The easing function used for the transition One of "linear", "quad", "cubic", "sin", "exp", "circle", "elastic", "back", "bounce", "linear-in", "quad-in", "cubic-in", "sin-in", "exp-in", "circle-in", "elastic-in", "back-in", "bounce-in", "linear-out", "quad-out", "cubic-out", "sin-out", "exp-out", "circle-out", "elastic-out", "back-out", "bounce-out", "linear-in-out", "quad-in-out", "cubic-in-out", "sin-in-out", "exp-in-out", "circle-in-out", "elastic-in-out", "back-in-out", "bounce-in-out".

ordering

Determines whether the figure's layout or traces smoothly transitions during updates that make both traces and layout change. One of "layout first", "traces first".

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_layout_transition() create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()).

See also

go_layout()
